timeline.description: In a stunning display of skill, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi made cricket history by scoring the fastest century in List A cricket for India A against the UAE. He reached the milestone in just 28 balls, highlighting India A's remarkable achievement of a team century in five overs. Though the UAE amassed 249 runs, Harpreet Singh Bhatia's 130 runs didn't diminish Sooryavanshi's pivotal role in propelling India A toward the semi-finals.
